title: Customs house impound ledger, page 41
author: P. Cray
notes: mw-e39.22: Cray's ledger entry for the crate of books (bible 6.1 quest 8), a clue for every Contraband Pages route. Placement on Cray's desk is a follow-up scene bead.

pages.text:
Crate seven. Consigned: M. Thorne, the Lamplit Stacks, Briar Glen. Eleven volumes, bound in the Saltmarch manner. One Restricted (Illusion: The Glasswright's Primer). Ten licensed. No writ. HELD.

Also held this month, pending writ: sundry restricted spellbooks, taken from travellers who did not declare them.

Note: I have read the Primer, naturally, to judge it. It is competent. It is also, I regret, rather good.

Note: the writ may be requested by post. Alternatively, evidence of a crime in this harbour is always received, and I am known to be grateful.
